why: rc16: empty boxes, level-range map label, tracker on the modern client, every name family coloured

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.0.0-rc16 (test build, built by wowfa2 CI).

Fix: zone headers in the quest list no longer flip between Persian, empty boxes and English (the map scan read our own Persian back and put the game font under it).
Fix: the world-map hover label with a level range ('Hillsbrad Foothills (20-30)') is Persian (the client colours the range).
Fix: the quest tracker no longer turns itself off on the modern client (it has no GetQuestLogTitle; C_QuestLog is used), so quest titles and objective lines in the quest list are Persian again.
Fix: every marked name is coloured: classes (also 'the hunter', 'Hunters', talent trees), game terms, items and objects got default colours.
Data: 123 more class / spell / term / zone names marked in spell and talent descriptions.
Includes rc7 to rc15.

Data from ForeverDB.net
